description: ArchProof benchmark — full inventory of every ONNX model used in the paper, with source URL and reproduction instructions. The total set is ~130 GB; it is NOT redistributed in this repository. Each entry tells the reviewer exactly where to fetch (or re-export) each model.

categories.name: Whole-model 6-7B-parameter LLM ONNX
categories.redistribution: not redistributed (~129 GB). Re-export from HuggingFace checkpoints with scripts/export_clean_llm.py and scripts/inject_llm_backdoor.py.

categories.name: ImageNet-pretrained torchvision backbones (production-scale, with injected backdoor gates)
categories.redistribution: not redistributed. Re-export from torchvision pretrained weights with scripts/inject_transformer_backdoor.py adapted to CNN.

categories.name: Medium-scale transformer encoders + 3 Bober-Irizar gate types each
categories.redistribution: not redistributed. Re-export from HuggingFace transformers with scripts/export_clean_transformers.py and scripts/inject_transformer_backdoor.py.

categories.name: CIFAR-CNN backdoors (Bober-Irizar 12-type taxonomy + 3 handcrafted extensions)
categories.redistribution: buildable from scratch via scripts/inject_*.py applied to a small CIFAR baseline CNN.

subgroups.kind: Handcrafted extensions to test non-classical trigger preprocessing

categories.name: Real-scan clean baseline (8 popular ONNX models — sanity test for false-positives)
Random-init torchvision backbones (14-model out-of-class case study)
categories.redistribution: not redistributed. Built with random init via scripts/export_clean_*.py with the --random-init flag.

categories.name: Synthetic stress-coverage clean models (modern architectural blocks)
categories.redistribution: buildable from scratch with PyTorch + torch.onnx.export. Each model is a self-contained nn.Module exercising one modern block (BiFPN, CBAM, ECA, ConvMixer, GhostNet, HardSwish, GeGLU, MHSA, attention pool, gated residual, etc.) with random weights.
categories.purpose: Test the verifier for false positives on modern architecture patterns that legitimately use Mul gates (SE blocks, attention, GLU, etc.).

categories.name: Adversarial G_i probe constructions (witness for G-condition necessity ablation)

models.name: clean_G1adv_dormant_add
models.purpose: G1-adversarial: dormant gate added back through Add (no-op clean)

models.name: clean_G4adv_ghost_mul
models.purpose: G4-adversarial: ghost Mul that does not influence output

categories.name: Open-world streaming scan (HuggingFace ONNX repos)
categories.redistribution: streamed dynamically — never persisted to disk. Per-repo verdicts are saved in results/.
categories.fetch_method: HuggingFace `library:onnx` topic, sorted by downloads, capped at 2 GB per model. Streaming scan loads each repo, runs admission + verifier, then unloads.

notes: The Bober-Irizar 22 variants use the original construction from CVPR 2023; gate operators (ReduceMax, Sub-routing, threshold-indicator) are documented in archproof/handcrafted_gdp.py.

Whole-model LLM ONNX exports use opset 14 with dynamic batch axis. Backdoored variants inject one Sigmoid+Mul gate at the final-layer SwiGLU MLP (Yi/DeepSeek/Mistral/Qwen2) or final-layer GeLU MLP (GPT-J).
All injection and clean-export scripts are in scripts/. Set ARCHPROOF_ROOT before running.
